description: Governed data work for business teams, right in ChatGPT. Prophecy DataGPT turns raw data into trusted analysis and reports using your team’s definitions, with inspectable workflows and code you can check and rerun.

defaultPrompt: Help me analyze my data with Prophecy DataGPT.
Reconcile these files against my warehouse data and flag mismatches.
Investigate this metric, explain what changed, and show the supporting workflow.
interface.longDescription: Your business context. Prophecy’s governed data work. Answers you can check and rerun, in ChatGPT. Explore data, reconcile records, clean and join messy sources, apply team definitions, and produce analysis and reports. Inspect each workflow step and its code, request changes in plain language, and rerun approved workflows on new data. Supports governed data workflows on your existing Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery environment through the connected Prophecy DataGPT service. Actual tools, access, and supported operations depend on the connected MCP server and your account permissions.

positive.description: Create a new project in the user's Prophecy workspace.
positive.prompt: Create a new Prophecy project called q3_revenue_analysis.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the q3_revenue_analysis project in the user's workspace and returns the project name with a link to open it in Prophecy.

positive.description: Read rows from a file in the user's Databox. The demo account has an orders.csv file with 240 sample orders.
positive.prompt: Show me the first 20 rows of my orders csv
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a preview of the file with its first 20 rows.

positive.description: Chart live warehouse data without saving anything.
positive.prompt: Chart total order amount by region for Q3 2025 from my orders table.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders a bar chart of total order amount for each of the 4 regions for July to September 2025, with a short summary of the totals. Nothing is saved.

positive.description: Show an existing data pipeline as a visual workflow. The demo account has the revenue_daily pipeline in the marketing_funnel project.
positive.prompt: Show me the revenue_daily pipeline in the marketing_funnel project.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders the revenue_daily pipeline as an interactive canvas showing each step and how they connect, without running it.

positive.description: Detect the tables inside an Excel workbook. Download orders_week42.xlsx from https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1iXXWcokY0mj_U-bJoWISOGAW08a3AxoL/edit?usp=drive_link&ouid=107690435958511781458&rtpof=true&sd=true and attach it to the message; it holds two tables on one sheet.
positive.prompt: Use Prophecy to analyse this workbook and show me the tables it contains.
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads the workbook to Prophecy and lists the 2 detected tables with their sheet, cell range and row count.
